name: An Urban Multi-Operator QoE-Aware Dataset
coverage: 2 km² around Sunway University, Selangor; 2024-12 to 2025-04
quality_note: 132 anonymous operator-node combinations; node positions are centroid-estimated and source-validated with OpenCellID/field inspection.

name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public (2021)
quality_note: DSM includes vegetation/buildings; terrain derivatives use a 3x3 neighborhood.

name: OpenStreetMap infrastructure via Overpass
quality_note: Community completeness varies; raw response timestamp is retained.

name: WorldPop Malaysia 2025 constrained population
grain: 2025 population summed in a 1 km square around each site
quality_note: 100 m alpha population estimates; value is exposure context, not a tower attribute.

name: NASA LIS 0.1° Very High Resolution Full Climatology
license: US Government work / NASA open data; Earthdata login required
quality_note: Not used: one cell cannot distinguish this ~2 km AOI and download requires user authentication.

name: OpenCellID Malaysia MCC 502 export
quality_note: Preferred ASEAN-scale source, but a registered API token is required; Sunway CC BY data is used for this pilot.

name: JRC Global Surface Water v1.4
quality_note: Recommended sensitivity layer; OSM vector distance is used in the present build.

name: Overture Maps buildings
quality_note: Recommended exposure QA against WorldPop; not a population substitute.

name: GHSL GHS-AGE R2025A
quality_note: Rejected as tower age: surrounding building-stock age is not equipment installation age.

name: Derived signal panel (per-session-per-node) + geometry residual
quality_note: 315 rows from 48 nodes and 22 sessions, after dropping nodes with <20 measurements (threshold set on median standard error ~3.1 dB, not tuned). link_distance_m derives from centroid-estimated node positions, so it is a control measured with error and under-controls path loss. Environment adds no held-out explanatory power over geometry here (incremental R2 -0.06 at n>=20, +0.02 at n>=30 — sign flips with threshold, i.e. noise). Per-node dB/month trend is exploratory only, n=36.
